name: MATÉ MATÉ 10-YEAR ANNIVERSARY @ SIGURD CPH
description:
In the summer of 2014, in the buzzing neighborhood of Nørrebro, what would become Denmark's favorite yerba iced tea was brewed, and ever since, Maté Maté has been Denmark’s go-to naturally caffeinated energy drink—100% organic and 100% refreshing. From lively concerts to unforgettable nights out, it’s been the ride-or-die for all your spirited adventures.
 
Now, as we celebrate a decade of this vibrant Nørrebro-native drink, we're throwing a spectacular carnival-themed bash on September 28th at Nørrebro’s very own Sigurd CPH! 🎠 In collaboration with Pana Radio and London party collective Shindig, the night promises to be a whirlwind of color, music, and merriment. Step right up to our Wheel of Fortune for a chance to win a ticket to Roskilde Festival 2025, test your aim with a classic can toss, and immerse yourself in a whimsical world of fairground fun while you sip on Maté Maté slush ice 🍧
 
Come join us for a night where the magic of the carnival meets the refreshing energy of Maté Maté—let’s make this anniversary one for the history books! 🎡 More info to come promptly, but for now mark your calendars ✔️ and prepare yourselves for an energizing, carnivalesque anniversary party.

Sigurdsgade 39, 2200
19 - 04
Free entrance till 23
120 dkk (wardrobe included) after 23
Age limit 21+

name: Olla Común 🥘 - South American Community Kitchen
description:
******ENGLISH BELOW******
Hola a todes
Les esperamos este jueves a las 18.00 en el primer piso de La Casa del Pueblo para la Olla Comun de cada mes. La comida se sirve a las 18.30!

Esta vez cocinaremos un plato del noreste de Brazil que se llama Baião de dois 😋 y como siempre lo haremos vegano.

Si todo sale bien, de nuevo tendremos musiquita y unos drinks aperitivos. Los esperamos!! ;)

Las donaciones de esta Olla iran a comunidades en Brazil y en el este de Bolivia. Durante las anteriores semanas, los incendios han arrasado con mucho del amazonas y como siempre la gente campesina e indigenas son las mas afectadas. Les contaremos mas en la Olla. Aqui un poco mas de informacion de los incendios:

https://www.dw.com/es/humo-de-incendios-en-brasil-y-bolivia-asfixia-sudam%C3%A9rica/a-70183768

Nos vemos!!

Se puede pagar con cash y tambien con MobilePay :)

-----------------------------------
Hi everyone!
Join us this Thursday for the monthly Olla Comun at 18.00 at the first floor of FolketsHus. Food is served at 18.30

This time we'll do some food from the north of Brazil called Baião de dois 😋 we'll veganize it as always

If all works out, once again we'll have some music and drinks ;)))

The donations for this Olla will be sent to comunities in the east of Bolivia and in Brazil. Over the last weeks, the fires in the amazon have devastated a massive amount of land. It is very bad and we will tell you more about it at the Olla. If you would like to read about them, here is an overview article about the fires:

https://www.wri.org/insights/amazon-forest-fires-2024

See you on Thursday! For donations we take cash and MobilePay
